en.bdb: Teachings from the example of Ganges

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਤਜਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: charanodhak hoi surasaree taj baiku(n)Th dharat vich aaiee|

en.bdb: Ganges, the wash of the Lords' feet, left heavens and came down to arth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਸੈ ਨਦੀ ਨੜਿੰਨਵੈ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: nau sai nadhee naRi(n)navai aThasaTh teerath a(n)g samaiee|

en.bdb: Nine hundred ninety nine rivers and sixty eight pilgrimage centres erged in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਲੈ ਸੀਸ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: tih loiee paravaan hai mahaadhev lai sees chaRhaiee|

en.bdb: In all the three worlds, it is accepted as authentic and Mahadev ,iva) has borne it on his head.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev sarevadhe jai jai kaar vaddee vaddiaaiee|

en.bdb: Gods and goddesses all worship it and hail s greatness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਣੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨਾਥਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: san ga(n)gaa baiku(n)Th lakh lakh baiku(n)Th naath liv laiee|

en.bdb: Myriads of heavens and the master of heavens including the ranges, absorbed in meditation declare,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂੜਿ ਦੁਲੰਭ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhoo dhooR dhula(n)bh hai saadhasa(n)gat satigur saranaiee|

en.bdb: That the dust of the feet of sadhu is rare and is obtainable only by coming under the shelter of the true Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਦਲ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: charan kaval dhal keem na paiee ||4||

en.bdb: Value of even the one petal of the lotus feet is beyond assessment.
